passage:
improve — 提高，改善
She wants to improve her English for her job.

course — 课程
Every Monday and Wednesday evening, she looks at English course websites on her phone.

usually — 通常
She usually studies at home after dinner.

slowly — 缓慢地
Lee, speaks slowly and clearly.

reviews — 复习
On Wednesday, she reviews her notes for 20 minutes.

rarely — 很少
She rarely watches English movies because she is tired in the evening.

confident — 自信的
She says, “I am learning a lot, and I am feeling more confident.”

saving — 节省，攒钱
She is also saving money for a new course.
